newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Jan debt default ratio rises to 0.21 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Jan debt default ratio rises to 0.21 pct.

text.p: The ratio of debt defaults to total outstanding debts for South Korean companies rose to 0.21 percent in January, up from 0.16 percent in December 1996, the central Bank of Korea said on Friday.
The bank said in a statement the rise was largely influenced by the Hanbo Steel Co's loan default in late January.
Hanbo Steel defaulted on repayments of promissory notes on January 23 after piling up about five trillion won in loans.
But the number of defaulting companies fell to 1,115 in January, compared with 1,238 in December, the central bank said.
